about_pullquote: I fix what the franchises say needs replacing.
about_para_1: Sunshine Auto Electrics has been diagnosing and repairing car electrical problems in Leeds for over 15 years. Started as a one-man operation by an experienced auto electrician, we've grown into a trusted workshop serving both private motorists and local fleet operators. We invest in the latest diagnostic equipment so we can pinpoint faults quickly and accurately — no trial and error.
about_para_2: The difference? We don't sell parts you don't need. Our reputation is built on honest diagnostics and fair pricing. Repeat customers come back because we listen, we explain what's happening, and we fix the problem properly the first time. We're based at Dolly Lane Business Centre in Harehills, easy to reach from across Leeds and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Took my Volkswagen in with an electrical fault — dealers wanted £800 for a new module. Sunshine diagnosed it as a dodgy connector, cleaned it up, and charged me forty quid. Saved me a fortune. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Battery died on a Sunday evening. Called Monday morning, they fitted a new one before lunch at half the price the main dealer quoted. Staff were friendly and explained everything. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sophie W.

reviews.text: My car kept having electrical gremlins — alternator, then something else. Took it to Sunshine. They found the root cause was a corroded battery terminal. Fixed it properly so it won't happen again. That's proper diagnostics.
reviews.author: David L.
